content:
[Intro]
[C]I got cotton in the
[G7]bottom land It's
up and growin' and I
[C]got a good stand
My good wife and them
[G7]kids of mine Gonna
get new shoes, come
[C]Pickin' Time
[G7]Get new shoes come
[C]Pickin' Time.

[Verse 1]
Ev'ry night when I
[G7]go to bed I
thank the Lord that my kids
[C]are fed They
live on beans eight
[G7]days and nine
But I
get 'em fat come
[C]Pickin' Time
[G7]Get 'em fat come
[C]Pickin' Time.
The

[Verse 2]
corn is yellow and the
[G7]beans are high The
sun is hot in the
[C]summer sky The
work is hard til
[G7]layin' by
Layin' by til
[C]Pickin' Time
[G7]Layin' by til
[C]Pickin' Time.
It's

[Verse 3]
hard to see by the
[G7]coaloil light And I
turn it off purty
[C]early at night 'Cause
a jug of coaloil
[G7]costs a dime
But I
stay up late come
[C]Pickin' Time
[G7]Stay up late come
[C]Pickin' Time.

[Verse 4]
My old wagon barely
[G7]gets me to town I
patched the wheels and I
[C]watered 'em down
Keep her in shape so she'll
[G7]be fine
To
haul my cotton come
[C]Pickin' Time
[G7]Haul my cotton come
[C]Pickin' Time.
Last

[Verse 5]
[C]Sunday mornin' when they
[G7]passed the hat It was
still nearly empty back
[C]where I sat But the
preacher smiled and said
[G7]that's fine The
Lord'll wait til
[C]Pickin' Time The
[G7]Lord'll wait til
[C]Pickin' Time.
title: Pichin' Time
tuning: E A D G B E
